places.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
places.ai_summary: A sacred temple located on Doi Suthep mountain, offering panoramic views of Chiang Mai and its surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Wear modest clothing as it is a sacred site.
places.address: Doi Suthep, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Old City Temples (Wat Chedi Luang, Wat Phra Singh)
places.ai_summary: A collection of historic temples within Chiang Mai's Old City, showcasing Lanna architecture and cultural heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Each temple may have slightly different hours.

places.place_tip: Carry a guidebook to understand the history of each temple.
places.address: Old City, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.ai_summary: A bustling night market offering a variety of goods, street food, and local crafts, perfect for evening exploration.

places.place_tip: Bargain politely when shopping for souvenirs.

places.ai_summary: A vibrant weekly market showcasing local handicrafts, art, and delicious street food, held every Sunday in the Old City.

opening_hours.notes: Only open on Sundays; arrive early for the best experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food delicacies.

places.name: Doi Inthanon National Park
places.ai_summary: Thailand's highest peak, offering stunning nature trails, waterfalls, and a chance to see the King and Queen Pagodas.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the cool season; dress warmly.

places.place_tip: Visit the Royal Project Gardens.
places.address: Doi Inthanon, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Elephant Nature Park
places.ai_summary: A rescue and rehabilitation center for elephants, offering a chance to learn about and interact with these gentle giants.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is essential; ethical interaction only.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and wear comfortable clothes.
places.address: 209/2 Sridom Chai Road, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Chiang Mai Zoo & Aquarium
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly attraction featuring a wide variety of animals and marine life, with opportunities for close-up encounters.

opening_hours.notes: Feeding sessions and shows have specific timings.

places.place_tip: Check out the panda exhibit and the aquarium tunnel.
places.address: 100 Huay Kaew Road, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Bua Thong Sticky Waterfalls
places.ai_summary: Unique waterfalls where visitors can climb up the cascades due to the limestone deposits, located in a lush jungle setting.

opening_hours.notes: Wear non-slip shoes for climbing the waterfalls.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby caves.
places.address: Bua Thong, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Chiang Mai Gate Market
places.ai_summary: A local market known for its authentic Thai street food, fresh produce, and vibrant atmosphere, especially in the evenings.

opening_hours.notes: Evening market is more vibrant and lively.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the mango sticky rice.
places.address: Chiang Mai Gate, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Nimmanhaemin Road
places.ai_summary: A trendy area known for its boutique shops, art galleries, cafes, and vibrant nightlife, popular among locals and tourists alike.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area by foot or rent a bicycle.

places.place_tip: Visit the art galleries and enjoy the local coffee shops.
places.address: Nimmanhaemin Rd, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Warorot Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market offering a wide range of products including local handicrafts, clothing, and delicious street food, popular with locals.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Try the local snacks and explore the textile section.
places.address: Warorot Market, Chiang Mai, Thailand

attribution.title: Warorot Market 01
attribution.author: Department of Tourism Thailand: LannaPhoto
attribution.description: Warorot market (Kat in northern Thai word) is "The Great Kat" which shows the everyday life as a social acquaintance, simple, convenient and economical. Diversity in agricultural products create colorful flower market from dawn to late night.

places.name: Royal Park Rajapruek
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park featuring stunning gardens, royal monuments, and a great place for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any special events or exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the park's website for event schedules.
places.address: Rajapruek Rd, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.ai_summary: A unique temple set in a forested area with ancient tunnels, a large stupa, and a peaceful atmosphere for meditation.

opening_hours.notes: Bring a flashlight to explore the tunnels.

places.place_tip: Participate in a meditation session if interested.
places.address: Wat Umong, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Mae Sa Elephant Camp
places.ai_summary: An elephant camp offering educational programs and the opportunity to observe elephants in a naturalistic setting.

opening_hours.notes: Ethical interaction with elephants; no riding.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby waterfalls.
places.address: Mae Sa, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Huay Tung Tao Lake
places.ai_summary: A scenic lake ideal for picnics, cycling, and enjoying the natural beauty of the Chiang Mai countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own food and drinks for a picnic.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area by bicycle.
places.address: Huay Tung Tao, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Art in Paradise 3D Museum
places.ai_summary: An interactive 3D art museum where visitors can take creative photos with 3D paintings and installations.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit with friends or family for a fun experience.
places.address: Art in Paradise, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Tha Phae Gate
places.ai_summary: A historic gate and a popular landmark in Chiang Mai, offering a glimpse into the city's past and a great photo opportunity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Sunday Walking Street Market.
places.address: Tha Phae Gate, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Chiang Mai Night Safari
places.ai_summary: A nocturnal zoo and safari park where visitors can see animals in a naturalistic night-time environment.

opening_hours.notes: Night safari tours start at 6:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Book the tram tour for a complete experience.
places.address: Chiang Mai Night Safari, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Wat Suan Dok
places.ai_summary: A beautiful temple known for its stunning white chedis and as a meditation center for monks.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in a meditation session if interested.

places.place_tip: Respect the monks and the meditation practices.
places.address: Wat Suan Dok, Chiang Mai, Thailand

places.name: Baan Kang Wat Artist Village
places.ai_summary: A charming artist village showcasing local art, handicrafts, and cozy cafes, set in a picturesque location.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any art exhibitions or workshops.

places.place_tip: Support local artists by purchasing their artworks.
places.address: Baan Kang Wat, Chiang Mai, Thailand
